title: A Survey on Graph Neural Networks for Remaining Useful Life Prediction: Methodologies, Evaluation and Future Trends
reasoning: The paper is a technical survey and benchmarking study focused on Graph Neural Network (GNN) methodologies for predicting the Remaining Useful Life (RUL) of industrial equipment. It is strictly an engineering and machine learning review for Prognostics and Health Management (PHM), containing no content or evaluation related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
